S1314.reason: Deliberate food production (cultivation and domestication) began with the Neolithic about 12,000–10,000 years ago, so the fitting window is the past 12,000 years.

S0967.reason: Flight recorders are painted bright international orange so wreckage searchers can see them; “black box” is only the nickname.

S0539.reason: Pizarro had a tiny force; Inca subject peoples had little loyalty to Cuzco and the empire was split by civil war, so local allies mattered more than horses, guns, or genius.

S0458.reason: Upper Paleolithic exchange was mostly long-distance luxury or exotic items; Mesolithic exchange moved a wider range of goods over shorter, more regional distances.

S1091.reason: The New Palace peak on Crete runs from the great earthquake that ended the Old Palaces (~1700 BCE / 3650 BP) to the Thera eruption that shattered the palaces (~1450 BCE / 3420 BP).
